column2: Reminiscent of the now 18-year-old Cappuccino project https://www.cappuccino.dev/

It would be interesting to see any benchmarks / comparisons to understand what are the benefits of having Swift in the browser. Is it faster? Easier to maintain? Or is it based more on the sympathy to the programming language in general?

But great job anyway!
sooner or later this was gonna happen. Swift is like Haskell, but nicer and more programmer-friendly.
Reminds me of Vapor - Swift, but on a server; https://www.vapor.codes/
Bit by bit, we are having our beloved browser plugins back, at least for some of us.
Fun project, an aside; Apple please fix the Swift compiler. It is so slow. It is so very slow.
Their demo is flakey and sometimes fails to hydrate in Firefox latest
Looks a bit like jQuery mixed with jsx and ember or angular
We already have Typescript, I don’t see the purpose.
